indicator.name: Hospital bed occupancy/utilisation rate
indicator.description: Hospital bed utilisation if a public Kenyan source is identified.
indicator.expected_source: Ministry of Health — Service Availability and Readiness Assessment (SARA) Main Report, Table 18
indicator.expected_availability_note: Retired/replaced in P21 because the official SARA report publishes only the national 46% bed-occupancy average, not a governed 47-county occupancy table. Use IND-INPATIENT-SERVICE-AVAILABILITY for the report's directly published 47-county inpatient-service availability percentages. Do not interpret that successor as bed occupancy/utilisation.
